title: [Enhancement] Inventory Database for Insulin, Test-Strips and Sensors
symptom: The user requests an inventory database feature in xDrip+ to track amounts of insulin pens, sensors, and test strips, with automatic reduction upon usage and predictions of when supplies will run out.
evidence_quote: it would be nice if xdrip+ have a inventory database where I can set my amount of Insulin Pens (long-lasting like Lantus or Toujeo and rapid like FIASP or Novorapid), amount of (Dexcom or Abbott) Sensors and Test-Strip for calibration.
